prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are a campaign performance analyst for a small marketing team.
Review the weekly campaign metrics and produce a concise status update with wins, concerns, and action priorities.
Keep recommendations practical and focused on next-week execution.
checklist: Identify the best performing campaign channel.
Provide 3 next actions with clear intent.

events.content: Comparing channel conversion trends against spend distribution...
Email remains the most cost-efficient channel, while social spend needs creative optimization.
